Sam Patel: Parking 12 visitor permit created, spot #V21. Need license plate to finalize. Also, candidate requested covered drop-off if it rains.

Jordan Lee: Loaner img: labeled and Wi-Fi preconfigured. Leaving a sticky with guest creds: SSID: Redwood-Guest PW: Guest2026! Also preinstalled Zoom.
Onboarding Bot: Temporary badge issued: VIS-79204, expires 2026-04-02 20:00.

Priya Kaur: Thanks team. I'll send an arrival email to Rafael with badge pickup, parking spot, and covered drop-off instructions. Ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
